speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have a history of easy bruising and are experiencing persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction. To determine if this is a sign of an underlying bleeding disorder, can you tell me how long the bleeding has been continuing?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A. The patient's age, post-extraction bleeding, easy bruising, and a family history of bleeding, bruising, and joint swelling strongly suggest an X-linked recessive bleeding disorder. While this clinical picture is highly suggestive, I will confirm the diagnosis with specific coagulation studies before finalizing the treatment plan.
